expectations.text: Treats the occupancy limit as a gate that is never traded against catering economics or a fuller room, rather than as an option on a ranked menu.
expectations.evidence: The transcript says this directly: "The room limit is a gate in this skill, not something to trade for a fuller room." It sets a hard stop at 250 at the door and rejects 700 outright ("700 is not an option"). It also rejects "register everyone and squeeze people in", saying turned-away registrants cost "more trust than an empty chair". Catering is sized from expected show-up and kept separate, so catering never pushes the limit. Even the waitlist batch must keep expected attendance under 250. The only way the limit moves is written venue approval for standing, obtained before registration open
